in_marathi.name: Brijamohan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Brij (Vrindavan)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brijamohan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brijamohan is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Brij' meaning 'forest' and 'Mohan' meaning 'enchanter' or 'charming'. This name signifies the one who is the lord of Brij, a sacred forest in India associated with Lord Krishna. The name carries a spiritual significance, symbolizing the charm and enchantment of the divine.
